Aaron (Partnerships): Heads-up: KeyWave Systems (hardware HSM vendor) pinged us about a marketplace connector that bundles SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and a Secrets Sync adapter for Redwood Private. Looking to coordinate tech, compliance evidence, and a joint launch webinar. Anyone available for a rapid sync? :satellite:
Mei (Security Eng): I can take the HSM/KMS security checklist. Need KeyWave's attestation reports (CC EAL / FIPS certs) and their PKCS#11 interface docs. Also want to confirm if they support remote attestation (TPM-like) or only local signing.
Tom (Product): For listing we should offer two SKUs: 1) "Partner-managed HSM (marketplace)" 2) "Onboarded by Redwood (professional services)". That way large customers can buy onboarding hours. Also need to lock down billing flow for reserved capacity with Dedicated.
Elena (Solutions): From an SI perspective, we need a mapping doc: how SCIM groups map to Redwood organization roles and how SAML attributes (eppn/email) translate to admin vs. read-only. I can draft a sample mapping.
Priya (Legal): Please collect export-control jurisdiction notes and whether key material ever leaves the HSM. If KeyWave offers an exportable key mode we need strict contract language and opt-in UI. I'll also need their SOC2 + any FedRAMP/National compliance statements.
Aaron (Partnerships): Good. Proposed timeline: this week: discovery + cert exchange; next week: dev connector + SCIM sample; week after: closed beta w/ SI partner; two weeks later: co-branded webinar + marketplace listing. OK?
Mei (Security Eng): Add operational tests: 1) key rotation exercise 2) simulated network partition where HSM is unreachable -> secrets-sync backoff behavior 3) log redaction test to ensure no key material or plaintext secrets in logs/metrics.
Tom (Product): We should also decide on listing copy. Draft tagline: "KeyWave HSM: hardware-backed key storage integrated with Redwood for secure inference and private deployments." Keep the claims limited to their attestation.
Elena (Solutions): SCIM snippet I'll propose for docs:

```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkRequest"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/Users",
      "data": {"userName":"alice@example.com","meta":{"active":true}}
    }
  ]
}
```

And a sample SAML metadata curl to fetch IdP certs for the connector: 

```
curl -s https://idp.example.com/metadata > idp.xml
# upload idp.xml to KeyWave console during connector setup
```

Mei (Security Eng): For the KMS API surface, ask KeyWave for their encrypt/decrypt WRAP/UNWRAP semantics. We require an HTTP endpoint that follows our KMS shim (POST /v1/kms/encrypt with key_id and plaintext blob). If they require client certs, note that in the marketplace metadata so customers know how to configure networking.
Priya (Legal): Also flag indemnity for key compromise and data exposure. Partner-managed means they accept primary responsibility; ensure our MSA appendix reflects that.
marketplace-bot: New listing draft ticket created: partners/keywave-hsm-integration (#2591).
Aaron (Partnerships): Action items: Mei = security checklist + tests; Elena = SCIM/SAML mapping + SI runbook; Tom = SKU + listing copy; Priya = contract language template; me = coordinate webinar and marketing assets. I'll schedule kickoff with KeyWave and the SI for Thursday 9am PT.
Tom (Product): One more product note  we should add a small UX hook in the marketplace: an "Enable secrets-sync" toggle that surfaces network requirements and whether data plane remains partner-managed.
Elena (Solutions): For the SI runbook, I'll add step-by-step: 1) establish SSO via SAML 2) verify SCIM provisioning 3) install secrets-sync adapter to Redwood Private 4) run key rotation and failover tests.
Mei (Security Eng): I'll prepare a short test harness that simulates HSM timeouts and asserts Redwood doesn't log plaintext. Share both on the call so we can run a quick demo.
Priya (Legal): Please also request a sample DPA and data processing notes from KeyWave. If they propose cross-border replication of backups we need to review.
Aaron (Partnerships): Great. If anyone has questions or wants to add items before Thursday, drop them here. We'll keep the launch conservative on compliance claims. :white_check_mark:
